project_type: Full-stack PV simulator - Python stdlib HTTP backend + Vanilla JS frontend
build_system: None - no build step. Run python3 backend/main.py to serve everything
test_framework: Python unittest in backend/tests/ (274 tests). No frontend test framework.
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3 backend/main.py to start server on port 8000. 2. Open http://localhost:8000 in browser. 3. Navigate through all steps of the PV simulation flow.
setup_instructions: No dependencies to install. Python stdlib only. Three.js from CDN.
environment_constraints: Vanilla JS only (no npm, no build tools, no frameworks). All text in Polish. Three.js from CDN via importmap. Python stdlib only. Comments in Polish.
contribution_requirements: All text/labels in Polish. No external dependencies. Must work by running python3 backend/main.py and opening localhost:8000.
key_patterns: Frontend uses ES modules for viewer.html (Three.js), regular scripts for other pages. Backend serves frontend/ directory as static files. API at /api/* endpoints. localStorage used for passing data between pages. CSS variables in style.css. Dark theme for viewer.css.
directory_structure: Root: backend/ (main.py, api/, services/, models/, data/, tests/), frontend/ (index.html, viewer.html, pages/, js/, css/), Dom.STL (3D model file)
